topic: Saturn has the most known moons
script: Saturn has more known moons than any other planet. As of 2025, astronomers count 274 of them. In a single announcement that year, 128 new moons were added. Most are tiny, irregular rocks just a few kilometers across. Many may be pieces of bigger moons that were smashed apart long ago. Its largest moon, Titan, is bigger than the planet Mercury.
